_comment: Single source of truth for all module repositories. Read by scripts/setup-modules.sh and deployment/docker/docker_deploy.sh.

core._comment: The main application repo. PUBLIC — no token required.

modules._comment: All module repos are PRIVATE (github.com/BorealTek/*). REPO_TOKEN (scope: repo) is required.

Action1.description: Action1 RMM integration — endpoint sync, remote script execution

AppHealth.description: Application health monitoring and status dashboards

CaseManager.description: AI-powered tier-0 case triage, research, and knowledge engine

ClientPortal.description: Customer-facing self-service portal with separate auth guard

Crm.description: Client and contact management, custom customer fields

DevFeedback.description: Internal developer feedback and issue tracking

EmailMigration.description: Email account migration tooling (spawns sibling containers via DooD)

GoogleAdmin.description: Google Workspace user sync and admin automation

KnowledgeBase.description: Internal and external documentation / knowledge base

MiddleMan.description: Integration middleware and diagram rendering (Kroki bridge)

PIB.description: Pre-installation briefing and client onboarding checklists

Payment.description: Stripe payment processing and invoice collection

WidgetRegistry.description: Composable widget slot system for UI composition
